name: hk_aqhi_high_risk_episode
requirements: Find the day in July 2025 with the most stations simultaneously recording AQHI >= 7, then drill into the peak hour. Turn 1: episode_date (str, YYYY-MM-DD), affected_stations (int). Turn 2: peak_hour (int), peak_aqhi (int), peak_station (str).

turns.query: In July 2025, on which day did the most air quality monitoring stations record an AQHI of 7 or above (high, very high, or serious health risk) at any hour? How many stations were affected? Return the date in YYYY-MM-DD format and the count of affected stations.
On that day, at which hour was the peak AQHI across all stations? What was the peak value and at which station? Return the hour (0-23), the AQHI value, and the station name.
